title: Graph neural network screen of 1.18 million CYTOP functional groups yields three polymer electrets with improved charge stability
summary: Mao et al. identified ionization potential as a descriptor of charging performance, used high-throughput calculations and graph neural networks to screen 1,176,591 functional groups on CYTOP, and synthesized three candidates as 15 micrometre films that held surface potentials above 3.1 kV in magnitude for over 1,500 h (extrapolated longevity 146 years at 80 C). Abstract-level review; baselines and measurement protocol not assessed, and the longevity figure is an estimate.
ai_technology: Graph neural network models with high-throughput computation

evidence.tested: Three predicted electrets were synthesized as films and their charge retention measured for over 1,500 h (per abstract).
evidence.unknown: Comparison with non-AI design baselines, device-level performance and full Methods were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Graph neural networks screened the candidate functional groups after a computed descriptor was identified.

source_review.scope: abstract and bibliographic metadata (Europe PMC) only; Methods and full text not assessed
